points: These are the divisions of the sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children, so Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office. David distributed them according to their offices in their service.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests

points: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar, sixteen of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar. They were divided by lot, one sort with another, and Shemaiah the scribe wrote them before the king and the princes, taking record for each.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests

points: The first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah, and so on through the twenty and four courses of the priests, each named in the order the lot fell. These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests

points: They had an order and directions on how they were to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests

points: The rest of the sons of Levi are named after the house of their fathers, family by family, down the line. These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

All these families come from particular bloodlines and particular families that were set over particular things. Just as Aaron's family was already chosen to do the priest's duties of the holy things, each house received its own service as an inheritance, kept in the family.
